extract: Vashj'ir (pronounced /vɒʒɪər/) is an underwater region located near the Eastern Kingdoms, off the western coast of Khaz Modan. Player characters can swim throughout the zone by jumping, but when on the ground it acts similarly to the terrestrial zones, and players can use special underwater mounts to move around it. In the Abyssal Depths is located the Abyssal Breach that allows you to reach the Abyssal Maw, which contains two 5-man dungeons. Unlike surface zones, the zones throughout Vashj'ir have no official night cycle. At night, Kelp'thar Forest, Shimmering Expanse, and Abyssal Depths appear fully lit by some sort of light source.

(off the western coast of [[Dun Morogh]] / [[Stormwind City]]) | territory = Contested }} '''Vashj'ir''' ({{pron|vɒʒɪər}}) is an underwater region located near the [[Eastern Kingdoms]], off the western coast of [[Khaz Modan]]. Player characters can swim throughout the zone by jumping, but when on the ground it acts similarly to the terrestrial zones, and players can use special underwater mounts to move around it. In the [[Abyssal Depths]] is located the [[Abyssal Breach]] that allows you to reach the [[Abyssal Maw]], which contains two 5-man dungeons. Unlike surface zones, the zones throughout Vashj'ir have no official night cycle. At night, [[Kelp'thar Forest]], [[Shimmering Expanse]], and [[Abyssal Depths]] appear fully lit by some sort of light source. ==History== Once a great [[Highborne]] city housing some of the most revered [[Night elf|night elves]] of [[ancient Kalimdor]], Vashj'ir was one of the royal cities in the days when [[Queen Azshara|Azshara]] was queen.[[An Occupation of Time]] The [[Ruins of Vashj'ir|ruins of the city]] located in the [[Shimmering Expanse]] were the home of [[Lady Vashj]],[http://static.mmo-champion.com/mmoc/images/news/2009/august/cataclysmpreviewpanel_078.jpg Blizzcon 2009 Cataclysm Panel] who was the daughter of [[Lestharia Vashj|Matron Lestharia Vashj]], the city's beloved ruler.[[Lestharia Vashj#Legacy|Lestharia Vashj's statue]] Following the [[War of the Ancients]] in 10,000 [[BDP]], Vashj'ir was swallowed by the [[Great Sea]] in the [[Great Sundering]]. At some point, the [[kvaldir]] led by [[Varkul the Unrelenting]][[Not Soon Forgotten]] were seen fighting the naga in the [[Shimmering Expanse]], as the latter wanted the city of Vashj'ir but mostly the [[Crucible of Nazsharin]] from them.[[Stolen Property]] During the battle, the kvaldir managed to steal the artifact that was to be used for the summoning ritual of [[Ozumat]], until the [[kraken]] was eventually summoned to wipe them out.[[Visions of the Past: The Slaughter of Biel'aran Ridge]] ===Cataclysm=== {{Cata-section}} {{Stub/Lore-section|Needs more in-game quests info}} Following the [[Cataclysm (event)|Cataclysm]] in 28 [[ADP]], [[Queen Azshara]] sent [[Lady Naz'jar]] and her loyal [[naga]] to Vashj'ir, where there was a rift to the [[Abyssal Maw]], the elemental realm of [[Neptulon]] the Tidehunter. The elemental lord had defied [[N'Zoth]]'s command, and rather than just destroying him, the [[Old God]] coveted his power to control the world's seas. With it, the naga could cut off all sea travel between the continents, splintering the world's nations into isolated enclaves. The [[Earthen Ring]] [[shaman]] eventually called for the help of the [[Horde]] and the [[Alliance]], who ventured beneath the waves and broke the strength of the naga and their allies.{{Ref WoWCV3|205}} ===Legion=== {{Legion-section}} By the time of the [[Burning Legion]]'s [[Third invasion of the Burning Legion|third invasion]] in 32 ADP, the [[naga]] in Vashj'ir were still active, and the champions of the [[Conclave]] were tasked to recover the [[:lumenstone]] they kept.[[Lumenstone: Vashj'ir]] ==Description from site== ''Once a great Highborne city housing some of the most revered night elves of Kalimdor, Vashj'ir was swallowed by the Great Sea in the Sundering and thought to be lost forever. Queen Azshara, formerly a beloved leader of the Highborne, escaped death in the depths of the sea when the Well of Eternity imploded. Such salvation came at a great cost, as the queen and many of her fellow Highborne were forever transformed into the monstrous naga, doomed to wander the seas for thousands of years. Their existence mostly remains a mystery to the peoples of modern Azeroth, though the Earthen Ring has learned of Azshara's naga seizing Vashj'ir for an unknown purpose as the cries of the elements echo across Azeroth from the Abyss.'' ;The Sunken City Vashj'ir is a level 80-82 zone in ''[[World of Warcraft: Cataclysm]]'' where players will be called to explore the depths of the [[Great Sea]] and stop the [[naga]] from seizing immeasurable power from the realm of [[Neptulon]] the Tidehunter. This expansive underwater zone will feature an unprecedented fight for survival against the naga overwhelming the area, several new quest hubs - including [[Alliance]] and [[Horde]] naval ships and [[submarine]]s - all-new underwater travel and combat mechanics, several pocketed undersea caves free from water's grip, a new five-player dungeon ([[Throne of the Tides]]), and the first-ever opportunity to explore the remains of the once-majestic city of Vashj'ir. ;Bottled Distress Message Found Adrift at Sea ''Need your help. Time is short. I'm held captive in what I hope to be a nightmare.'' ''Enjoying the ocean air just days ago. We were determined to control key trade routes through victory at sea over the [[Horde]]. Their fleet came into our scopes. Our world became the deafening sound of battle, the smell of gunpowder, and the feeling of fear. Looking back now, though, that wasn't real fear.'' ''We weren't alone in those waters. Our naval warfare attracted attention and rendered us prey. With our vessel already torn apart and taking on water, we saw a tremendous creature rise from the depths and shatter the hull, sucking us down to the sea floor. It all happened so fast. I was quick to tread the waters, hoping to regroup with any survivors I could find through a dense [[Kelp'thar Forest|garden of kelp]], constantly gasping for a chance breath. That's when the onslaught began. From all directions swarms of brutal [[naga]] swept through and captured a great many of us. Beaten near to death, I awoke in agony, bound in chains.'' ''And here I still sit. I can only describe our prison as very big and somehow very much alive. We're in the hands of the naga now. Surviving crewmates in better condition than me are driven into slave labor.'' ''One escaped. Thomas. He didn't make it far before I saw him dragged back. Before being forced into labor, he spoke in a panic about some [[Nespirah|large shell]] protecting this living prison, expansive [[night elf]] ruins in the distance, strange naga rituals underway, and [[Kvaldir|sea vrykul]] battling our captors. He made little sense. Could be mad. Or I could be mad to hope [[vrykul]] are fighting to free us.'' ''Prison patrols out again. Send word to [[Stormwind]]. Sunken city far from extinct. Naga plotting something horrific. Please help.''[https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-gb/news/9986542/vashjir-surviving-the-depths Vashj'ir: Surviving the Depths] ==Geography== ===Maps and subregions=== [[File:WorldMap-Vashjir.jpg|thumb|300px|left|Map of Vashj'ir.]] {| class="darktable hlist" |- | *{{Horde}} ''[[Galerek's Remorse]]'' *{{Alliance}} ''[[The Intrepid]]'' *{{Horde}} ''[[The Iron Reaper]]'' *{{Horde}} ''[[Stygian Bounty]]'' *{{Alliance}} ''[[The Tidebreaker]]'' *{{Alliance}} ''[[Voldrin's Hold]]'' |- || ---- ;[[Undisplayed location]]s *''[[Edgar Fish 'N' Sea]]'' |- || ---- ;[[Lore location]]s *''[[Vaesska]]'' |} {{clear|left}} ===Zones=== All zones are currently for levels {{level|vashj'ir}}. *{{cata-inline}} [[Kelp'thar Forest]] *{{cata-inline}} [[Shimmering Expanse]] *{{cata-inline}} [[Abyssal Depths]] ==Vashj'ir quests== {{Main|Vashj'ir quests}} Vashj'ir plays out as one long, cohesive storyline, from the very beginning in [[Kelp'thar Forest quests|Kelp'thar Forest]] when players find themselves shipwrecked by [[Ozumat]], through the [[Shimmering Expanse quests|Shimmering Expanse]], where players come to the horrible realization of just what the naga are planning for Azeroth, and climaxing in the [[Abyssal Depths quests|Abyssal Depths]], as players try to defend [[Neptulon]] from the naga forces' attack. ==Resources== *Herbalism **[[Azshara's Veil]] **[[Stormvine]] *Mining **[[Obsidium Ore]] ==Wild creatures== *[[Crab]]s *[[Deep sea murloc]]s *[[Eel]]s *[[Faceless one]]s *[[Gilgoblin]]s *[[Grouper]] *[[Naga]] *[[Puffer fish]] *[[Ray]] *[[Seahorse]]s *[[Shark]]s (including the [[Whale Shark (Vashj'ir)‎|Whale Sharks]]) *[[Snail]]s ==Refuges== Air-filled caves are scattered throughout the continent. Explorers can spot their entrances by searching for yellow tube worms with purple shells. Here, adventurers can place campfires and eat food. Some refuges have an innkeeper, vendors, seahorse point, and even a mailbox. Often, these NPCs are added by completing phased quests. These refuges are often informally called "save caves" due to the way the [[#How to get to Vashj'ir|city port]] works when sending players to the zone. They are listed here in order of appearance: #{{Neutral}} [[Smuggler's Scar]], Kelp'thar Forest #{{Neutral}} [[Deepmist Grotto]], Kelp'thar Forest #{{Neutral}} [[Damplight Chamber]], Shimmering Expanse #{{Neutral}} [[Silver Tide Hollow]], Shimmering Expanse #{{Horde}} [[Legion's Rest]] / {{Alliance}} [[Tranquil Wash]], Shimmering Expanse #{{Horde}} [[Tenebrous Cavern]] / {{Alliance}} [[Darkbreak Cove]], Abyssal Depths ==How to get to Vashj'ir== [[File:VZ-Eastern Kingdoms.jpg|thumb|Vashj'ir is off the west coast of the [[Eastern Kingdoms]].]] * The intended way to get to Vashj'ir for the first time is via one of the breadcrumb quests: [[To the Depths]], [[Hero's Call: Vashj'ir!]] or [[Warchief's Command: Vashj'ir!]]. ** Alliance players are sent to [[Stormwind Harbor]] to the northernmost dock. With one of these quests in the quest log, players are in another phase where a mercenary ship appears instead of the normal ship to [[Borean Tundra]]. This mercenary ship then takes them to Vashj'ir. ** Horde players are sent to [[Bladefist Bay]] just to the southeast of [[Orgrimmar]], where a mercenary ship phases in. * ''After'' getting shipwrecked and completing [[Call of Duty (quest)]], there is a portal from the [[Western Earthshrine]] in [[Orgrimmar]] and from the [[Eastern Earthshrine]] in [[Stormwind City]]. This sends players to a refuge such as Smuggler's Scar or Silver Tide Hollow depending where on the quest progression they are; the most recently-unlocked refuge is generally chosen. * Players can fly to Vashj'ir with a flying mount: fly directly west from [[Dun Morogh]], west-north-west from the [[Stormwind Harbor]] lighthouse or south-west from [[Ruins of Gilneas]]. Players will fly over the [[fatigue]] waters between the continents and it will take 280% flying skill to reach Vashj'ir before dying to fatigue. * There is a flight point at [[Sandy Beach]], a thin strip of sandy land just above [[Kelp'thar Forest]], that is directly connected to Undercity and Ironforge respectively. From there one can utilize the sea horse "flight" service to travel between the various caverns/quest hubs in Vashj'ir. No quests take players to Sandy Beach directly, however. * A Restoration [[druid]] can easily reach Vashj'ir with the [[Wild Charge]] talent, two [[Swim Speed Potion]], a healing potion, a mana potion and some [[elixir]]s. Fly to [[Menethil Harbor]] and then go to the closest point to Vashj'ir. * South-east of [[Gnomeregan]] there is a passage that leads to the nearby mountains. Climb them until you reach the forest west of Gnomeregan. Go through the forest to the mountains on the other side. Find the tall mountain that is the closest to Vashj'ir. You will need a [[Goblin Glider Kit]]. When you arrive, avoid the sharks and head to the [[Lightless Reaches]]. Go a little bit south and enter the cavern. Exit it on the other side and go up. You will find a flight master who has the flightpaths to the Eastern Kingdoms and one who has the flightpaths to other Vashj'ir locations. ==Notes== *The [[Vashj'ir Honor Guard]]s are likely from here. *Vashj'ir is one of the zones in ''Cataclysm'' that heavily features [[underwater walking]] as a constant feature. *If a character dies a certain distance away from Vashj'ir, they'll reappear in the graveyard in [[Ruins of Lordaeron]] (if they're Horde) or [[Faol's Rest]] (if they're Alliance) in [[Tirisfal Glades]], despite this zone being far away from Vashj'ir. ==Gallery== File:Vashj'ir.jpg|[[Clutch]] File:Vashj'ir 2.jpg File:Vashj'ir 3.jpg File:Chron3 map of Azeroth after the Cataclysm.jpg|Vashj'ir seen on a map in ''[[World of Warcraft: Chronicle Volume 3|Chronicle Volume 3]]''.
